verdicts.reason: Near-identical layouts. Both stretch the dark panel flush to the left and right canvas edges, cutting off its side margins. The can is shrunk and sits in a large dead gap below the headline. A runs the panel off the bottom, which reads as a deliberate bottom sheet. B stops the panel about 10px short of the bottom, leaving an awkward sliver of green that looks like a mistake, so A is very slightly cleaner.

A keeps the logo centred on the same axis as the headline, can and CTA. Its flaws are the panel bleeding off the sides and the dead space around a small can. B pushes the logo to the top-right, off the central axis everything else uses, which breaks alignment and the original's symmetric brand lockup. B's slightly larger can and CTA don't make up for that, and its panel still bleeds off the sides.
